title: Nurx tretinoin cream: strengths, cost and FutureClinic - FutureClinic
summary: Nurx tretinoin cream strengths, November 2026 prices ($90 per 45 g tube plus fees), ReviveRx details, and how a FutureClinic dermatologist compares.
body_markdown:
Through[Nurx](https://www.nurx.com/skincare-treatments/) , you can get generic tretinoin cream in 0.025%, 0.05%, or 0.1% after an online photo intake reviewed by a[state-licensed](https://futureclinic.com/blog/nurx-vs-futureclinic-acne-and-birth-control) clinician (MD, NP, PA, or RN in Nurx's words). Cash price in November 2026 is $90 per 45 g, 3-month tube, plus a $40 acne or $30 anti-aging consult and a $3 support fee in each month an order is processed; compounded ReviveRx is "not FDA-approved." A FutureClinic dermatologist can prescribe[generic tretinoin](https://futureclinic.com/blog/how-to-get-tretinoin-online-no-subscription) by message, with no subscription required, to the pharmacy you choose ([GoodRx](https://www.goodrx.com/tretinoin) : about $35 to $63 per 45 g, November 2026).


## What tretinoin creams does Nurx sell?


Nurx sells generic[tretinoin cream](https://www.nurx.com/retinoid/tretinoin-cream/) in 0.025%, 0.05%, and 0.1% for acne, anti-aging ("Generic Retin-A"), and dark spots, with a provider picking the strength. Its plain tretinoin comes only as a cream; its retinoid gel is adapalene 0.3%. One 45 g tube lasts 3 months (or, for acne, a 20 g, 2-month tube for $60 if you ask your provider, as of November 2026). Nurx says cash-pay patients get the same FDA-approved medication as insured patients. On[DailyMed](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/search.cfm?query=tretinoin+cream) , tretinoin cream is FDA-approved for acne vulgaris;[MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/druginfo/meds/a682437.html) says tretinoin is also used to reduce fine wrinkles.


## What is Nurx ReviveRx cream?


[ReviveRx Cream](https://www.nurx.com/retinoid/reviverx-anti-aging-cream/) is Nurx's compounded anti-aging formula in a 26 mL bottle, sold only by Nurx, combining tretinoin (0.025%, 0.05%, or 0.1%) with azelaic acid 10%, niacinamide 4%, hyaluronic acid, and ceramides. Nurx states ReviveRx, its Dark Spots Formula, and its hair-loss spray are compounded and not FDA-approved. The[FDA](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/human-drug-compounding/compounding-and-fda-questions-and-answers) does not verify or approve compounded drugs, and DailyMed lists no label combining tretinoin with azelaic acid.


## How much does Nurx tretinoin cost in total?


A year of cash-pay acne tretinoin from Nurx in four 45 g, 3-month tubes is $412 as of November 13, 2026: a $40[acne consult](https://www.nurx.com/acne-treatment/) , four $90 tubes ($360), and a $3[support fee](https://www.nurx.com/faq/what-is-the-support-fee/) in each month an order is processed ($12). Nurx's pages give two "from" prices for acne topicals: $20 a month ([cost FAQ](https://www.nurx.com/faq/how-much-does-nurx-cost/) ) and $25 (acne page). Anti-aging consults are $30; ReviveRx is $90 per 3 months on its product page. Nurx takes most private insurance plans for acne and rosacea prescriptions, never for the consult, anti-aging medicine or government plans, and charges the $3 fee at local pharmacies too.


At the pharmacy you choose, GoodRx listed generic tretinoin cream on November 13, 2026 at $34.85 to $62.91 for 45 g ($25.06 to $32.95 for 20 g), where insurance may cover it; for a stable medicine, the doctor can prescribe several months at once when they judge it safe.


## How does the Nurx skincare plan work?


After an online photo intake,[state-licensed MDs, NPs, PAs, or RNs](https://www.nurx.com/faq/who-are-your-doctors/) review your case while a board-certified dermatologist Medical Director advises the team. For acne, a provider checks in at about 10 weeks, acne care includes a year of follow-up before a new consult fee, and replies take "within a few business days or sooner." Opt-in auto-refills renew until you cancel 48 hours before billing; reviewed consult fees are non-refundable. Nurx's "100% Satisfaction Guarantee" for anti-aging in[Thirty Madison's terms](https://patient.thirtymadison.com/legals/terms-and-conditions) , for a first subscription on or after September 24, 2026, refunds medicine costs (not support fees) on eight anti-aging products, plain tretinoin included, after 180 days of continuous use with photos and a 30-day claim. Nurx treats mild and moderate acne, its acne services are "not offered in every state," and it prescribes no isotretinoin, excludes tretinoin in pregnancy or nursing, and lists "teens and adults" or 18+ for acne (18+ for anti-aging).


## How do you use tretinoin cream safely?


Apply tretinoin nightly, waiting 20 to 30 minutes after washing so skin is dry, using enough to cover the area lightly. Extra cream will not act faster, and strength or frequency changes follow tolerance with a[dermatologist](https://www.aad.org/public/diseases/acne/derm-treat/treat) . Acne may get worse during the first 7 to 10 days, and some people see new blemishes by 3 to 6 weeks; the label says neither is a reason to stop. Improvement takes at least 6 to 8 weeks (AAD) and 6 to 12 weeks for continued improvement (label). Early redness and peeling usually settle within 2 to 4 weeks, per the[DailyMed](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/search.cfm?query=tretinoin+cream) patient leaflet. Keep it off the eyes, ears, mouth, nose corners, sunburn, and eczema, wear SPF 30+ water-resistant broad-spectrum sunscreen, and avoid benzoyl peroxide or salicylic acid unless directed. Ask a doctor if pregnant or nursing, and call if you become pregnant.
